name: Kunal Kamra Heckling Arnab Goswami
visual_description: Split image of comedian Kunal Kamra animatedly talking on the left and news anchor Arnab Goswami silently ignoring him with sunglasses and earphones on an IndiGo flight.
usage_context: Used to represent one person rambling, complaining, or trying to provoke someone while the other remains completely unbothered and detached.

example.left_text: Me explaining why my startup idea will change the world
example.right_text: My dad looking at his newspaper

text_areas.description: Text describing the person talking endlessly or trying to get attention
Text describing the person completely unbothered and ignoring the noise
